name: How long does it take to widen a laundry room doorway?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to widen a laundry room doorway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a laundry room doorway widening project typically spans 1 to 3 days. This timeline accounts for demolition, any necessary framing adjustments, drywall installation, mudding, sanding, and painting. If structural changes are required, or if unforeseen issues arise, the project might extend slightly. We always aim for efficient completion while maintaining high-quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Widening a laundry room doorway usually takes 1 to 3 days, depending on the complexity of the work and necessary finishes.
